runs.name: chaos-01-w
runs.task: Add a pause menu: pressing Escape during gameplay pauses the game (get_tree().paused = true) and shows an overlay with Resume and Quit to Menu buttons. Resume unpauses; Quit navigates to the main menu. The overlay should match the neon aesthetic (dark background, cyan text). Pressing Escape again should also resume.
